title: Hoeffding's extrema of the number of successes at a fixed mean
summary: For n independent trials with success probabilities p_1, ..., p_n in [0,1] -- Poisson trials -- and S the number of successes, three results about how the law of S varies over all trial vectors with a given mean lam, with pbar = lam/n the common success probability of the homogeneous trials of the same mean. First, for g convex on the integer grid, E[g S] is maximised by the binomial, and under strict grid convexity equality holds exactly at the constant vector (Hoeffding's Theorem 3).
